kinds.d: Program for browsing, copying, moving, renaming and organising files and folders, often in two panes.
Program that packs files into compressed archives and unpacks them.
Program that shows and controls another computer's screen over a network, here for personal and home use.
Program that indexes a computer's files and finds them by name or content.
Program that opens applications, files and commands from a typed name or shortcut.
Program that writes data, audio or disc images to optical discs.

notes: Restraint-only. File manager 52->20: built-in OS and mobile managers, leading paid and free dual-pane tools, main terminal managers, Norton Commander kept as the icon of the orthodox pane style; dropped historic shells (DOS Shell, ViewMAX, GeoManager, PC Shell, XTree, PathMinder, Volkov Commander, DOS Navigator), minor Linux and X11 managers, WinSCP (SSH/FTP client shelf) and tag tool Tabbles. File archiver 51->16 (PKZIP and StuffIt kept as icons; dropped niche, regional and dead tools). Remote desktop 52->14 personal-use tools per brief; dropped enterprise/VDI products (Citrix XenApp, Oracle SGD, Sun Ray, Ericom, GO-Global, ThinLinc, NetSupport, ScreenConnect, Goverlan, IBM Director, etc.) and discontinued tails (pcAnywhere, Timbuktu, Netviewer). Desktop search 28->11 (Google Desktop kept as icon). App launcher 23->10 (dropped docks and start-menu replacements of the past, PortableApps platform). Disc burning 38->14 (dropped pro authoring suites such as DVD Studio Pro, Adobe Encore, TMPGEnc, and dead tools). Old ranges dropped. No new kinds.
